title: ModelAiExecutionConfig
description: Canonical JSON contract for agnostic AI execution intent in jocaagura_domain.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature requested for the provider.

topP.description: Top-p nucleus sampling value requested for the provider.

topK.description: Top-k sampling value requested for the provider.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens requested for the response.

seed.description: Preferred deterministic seed when the provider supports it.

stopSequences.description: Optional list of stop sequences requested for generation.

deterministicPreferred.description: Agnostic intent that the request should favor reproducible outputs when possible.
